property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Two replicas: tolerates one DataNode failure without data loss.

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: NameNode metadata directory (a named volume in compose).

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: DataNode block directory (one named volume per worker).

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: 128 MiB blocks: one mapper per block for the line-oriented jobs.

property.name: dfs.namenode.handler.count
property.description: Enough RPC threads for 3 workers running many parallel tasks.

property.name: dfs.datanode.max.transfer.threads
property.description: Avoids the classic "xceiver count exceeded" failure under shuffle load.

property.name: dfs.permissions.enabled
property.description: Lab cluster: permissions would add nothing to the experiment and can fail writes.
